trials.title: PA-001 Ph.1 Study in Healthy and Elderly Subjects

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events after single and multiple IV dosed of PA-001 in healthy subjects
Incidence of laboratory abnormalities (hematology, clinical chemistry and urinalysis test)

reasons: one of only 1 trials at this company

trials.title: A Study of Theranostic Pair PD-32766D/T in Participants With Carbonic Anhydrase IX Positive Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number and proportion of participants who experience at least 1 dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs).
Incidence, intensity, seriousness, and causality of adverse events (AEs), treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs), adverse event of special interest (AESI) and serious adverse events (SAEs).
Incidence of TEAEs leading to dose delay, dose interruption, dose reduction, and/or discontinuation.
Maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and the recommended dose for expansion (RDE) of PD-32766T based on dose-limiting toxicities.

reasons: one of only 1 trials at this company
trials.commentary: Ph 1, open-label. Targeting 60 patients. Started Jul 2026, primary completion May 2029. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.
